== Course of events ==

After Jack Pumpkinhead and the Saw-Horse arrive before the green wall of the Emerald City, the Scarecrow, believing that he and his visitors speak different languages, calls for an interpreter to be brought in. It is in this moment that Jack Pumpkinhead admits his mistake in assuming that an interpreter was needed.

The admission clears the way for Jack Pumpkinhead to meet His Majesty the Scarecrow, ruler of the Emerald City, directly. Nevertheless, Jellia Jamb, born in the North Country, is brought in to translate between them, and she mischievously mistranslates their words, making each seem to insult the other.
